###get clinical data

```{r}
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
gse <- getGEO("GSE282122", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
if (is.list(gse)) gse <- gse[[1]]

# 取样本表（phenoData）
pheno <- pData(gse)

# 查看所有可用字段名
colnames(pheno)


```

#成人IBD课题

```{r}
setwd("data")  
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(scRNAtoolVis)
clusterCols <- c("#843C39", "#8C6D31", "#E6550D", "#3182BD", "#54990F",
                 "#BD9E39", "#E7BA52", "#31A354", "#E41A1C", "#6BAED6",
                 "#9ECAE1", "#AD494A", "#A1D99B", "#C7E9C0", "#99600F",
                 "#C3BC3F", "#D6616B", "#FF7F00", "#1B9E77", "#FDAE6B", 
                 "#66A61E", "#F1788D", "#E6550D", "#E7969C")



cell_colors <- c(
  "#96cada",   # Light blue
  "#4eb144",   # Light green
  "#a7d492",          # Light gray
  "#347bae",           # Yello
  "#fb8484",      # Khaki
  "#fdb26f",           # Thistle
```

####导入临床信息，提取metadata，合并临床信息

```{r}
###读入rds
scrna_ibd <- readRDS("data/UC/uc_merge_data_disease_filterover.rds")
###提取临床信息
scrna_ibd1 <- subset(scrna_ibd,group != 'UC-self control')
rm(scrna_ibd)
```

####重新进行整合质控

```{r}
obj <- scrna_ibd1
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
## Ⅰ. 基因过滤：>3 个细胞中表达
counts <- GetAssayData(obj, slot = "counts")  
selected_f <- rownames(obj)[Matrix::rowSums(counts > 0) > 3]
genes_before <- nrow(obj)
obj <- subset(obj, features = selected_f)
genes_after <- nrow(obj)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(obj, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
## Ⅱ. 添加 QC 特征
obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
obj[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^HB[AB]")

## Ⅲ. 细胞过滤
n_before <- ncol(obj)
obj<- subset(obj,
              subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &
                nFeature_RNA < 6000 &
                percent.mt   < 15 &
                percent.hb   < 1)
n_after <- ncol(obj)
process <- data.frame(
  cells_before = n_before,
  cells_after  = n_after,
  genes_before = genes_before,
  genes_after  = genes_after)
feats <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA")
table(obj$orig.ident)

p1=VlnPlot(obj, group.by = "orig.ident", features = feats, pt.size = 0, ncol = 2) + 
  NoLegend()
w=length(unique(obj$orig.ident))/3+5;w

feats <- c("percent.mt",  "percent.hb")
p2=VlnPlot(obj, group.by = "orig.ident", features = feats, pt.size = 0, ncol = 2, same.y.lims=T) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 100, 5)) +
  NoLegend()
p3=FeatureScatter(obj, "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA", group.by = "orig.ident", pt.size = 0.5)
p=p1+p2+p3
ggsave(filename="QC_PROCESS.pdf",plot=p,width = 100*w,height = 100*w,limitsize = FALSE)
library(scDblFinder)
library(BiocParallel)
getwd()
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(obj)
sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples = sce$orig.ident, BPPARAM = SnowParam(2))
# 写回标签
obj$scDblFinder.class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
table(obj$scDblFinder.class)

###dbcell result present
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, 
                     normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                     scale.factor = 1e4) 
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(obj)
obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = obj))
library(harmony)
obj <- RunHarmony(obj, "orig.ident")

obj <- RunUMAP(obj,  dims = 1:15, 
               reduction = "harmony")
p <- DimPlot(obj,reduction = "umap",label=T,group.by = 'scDblFinder.class' ) 
ggsave(filename="doublecell_process.pdf",plot=p,width = 15,height = 15)
db_result <- table(obj$scDblFinder.class)
# 保留 singlet
obj_filter <- subset(obj, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
sce.all.filt <-obj_filter
sce.all.filt <- NormalizeData(sce.all.filt, 
                              normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor = 1e4) 
sce.all.filt <- FindVariableFeatures(sce.all.filt)
sce.all.filt <- ScaleData(sce.all.filt)
sce.all.filt <- RunPCA(sce.all.filt, features = VariableFeatures(object = sce.all.filt))
library(harmony)
sce.all.filt <- RunHarmony(sce.all.filt, "orig.ident")

sce.all.filt <- RunUMAP(sce.all.filt,  dims = 1:15, 
                        reduction = "harmony")
DimPlot(sce.all.filt,reduction = "umap",label=T,group.by = 'orig.ident' ) 
sce.all.filt <- FindNeighbors(sce.all.filt, reduction = "harmony",
                              dims = 1:15) 
for (res in c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5,0.8,1)) {
  sce.all.filt=FindClusters(sce.all.filt, #graph.name = "CCA_snn", 
                            resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}
library(clustree)
p2_tree=clustree(sce.all.filt@meta.data, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
p2_tree
DimPlot(sce.all.filt,group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.3")
FeaturePlot(sce.all.filt,features  = c('PTPRC','EPCAM'))
```

#注释 ##major注释

```{r}

genes_to_check = c('EPCAM','KRT19','CLDN4',  #上皮
                   'PECAM1' , 'CLO1A2', 'VWF',  #基质
                   'PTPRC','CD3D', 'CD3E', 'CD8A', 'CD4','CD2', #T
                   'CDH5', 'PECAM1', 'VWF',  #内皮
                   'LUM' , 'FGF7', 'MME',  #成纤维
                   'AIF1', 'C1QC','C1QB','LYZ',  #巨噬
                   'MKI67', 'STMN1', 'PCNA',  #增殖
                   'CPA3' ,'CST3', 'KIT', 'TPSAB1','TPSB2',#肥大
                   'GOS2', 'S100A9','S100A8','CXCL8', #中性粒细胞
                   'KLRD1', 'GNLY', 'KLRF1','AREG', 'XCL2','HSPA6', #NK
                   'MS4A1','CD19', 'CD79A','IGHG1','MZB1', 'SDC1',  #B
                   'CSF1R', 'CSF3R', 'CD68') #髓系
p = DotPlot(sce.all.filt, features = unique(genes_to_check),group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.3",
                assay='RNA'  ) + coord_flip()
p
ggsave(filename="major_annotation2.pdf",plot=p,width = w,height = w)

celltype=data.frame(ClusterID=0:17,
                    celltype= 0:17) 
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(4),2]='Epithelial'
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(0,1,13,14,15,16,2,3,7,8),2]='Immune'
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(10,11,12,17,5,6,9),2]='Stromal'

sce.all.filt@meta.data$marjor_type = "NA"
for(i in 1:nrow(celltype)){
  sce.all.filt@meta.data[which(sce.all.filt@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.0.3==celltype$ClusterID[i]),'marjor_type'] <- celltype$celltype[i]}
table(sce.all.filt@meta.data$marjor_type)

cellRatioPlot(object = major_annotation,
              sample.name = "group",
              celltype.name = "marjor_type")
p <- DimPlot(sce.all.filt,group.by = "marjor_type",reduction = 'umap')
ggsave(filename="major_umap.pdf",plot=p,width = w,height = w)
DimPlot(major_annotation,group.by = "marjor_type",reduction = 'umap',label = T)
saveRDS(sce.all.filt,file = 'major_annotation.rds')
```

```{r}
major_annotation <- readRDS("data/major_annotation.rds")
IBD_immune <- subset(major_annotation,marjor_type=='Immune')
sce.all.filt <- IBD_immune
sce.all.filt <- NormalizeData(sce.all.filt, 
                              normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                              scale.factor = 1e4)

sce.all.filt <- RunPCA(sce.all.filt, features = VariableFeatures(object = sce.all.filt))

sce.all.filt <- RunUMAP(sce.all.filt,  dims = 1:15,

                              dims = 1:15) 
for (res in c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5,0.8,1)) {
  sce.all.filt=FindClusters(sce.all.filt, #graph.name = "CCA_snn", 
                            resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}
library(clustree)
p2_tree=clustree(sce.all.filt@meta.data, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")

cellRatioPlot(object = sce.all.filt,
              sample.name = "disease_rank",
              celltype.name = "RNA_snn_res.0.5")

            group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5",
                assay='RNA'  ) + coord_flip()
gene_list <- list(
  Epithelial = c("EPCAM","KRT19","CLDN4"),
  
  Stroma = c("PECAM1","CLO1A2","VWF"),
  
  T_cells = c("PTPRC","CD3D","CD3E","CD8A","CD4","TRDC",'FOXP3'),
  
  Macrophage = c("AIF1","C1QC","C1QB","LYZ"),
  
  Proliferation = c("MKI67","STMN1","PCNA"),
  
  Mast_cells = c("CPA3","CST3","KIT","TPSAB1","TPSB2"),
  
  Neutrophil = c("GOS2","S100A9","S100A8","CXCL8"),
  
  NK = c("KLRD1","GNLY","KLRF1","AREG","XCL2","HSPA6"),
  
  B_cells = c("MS4A1","CD19","CD79A","IGHG1","MZB1","SDC1"),
  
  Myeloid = c("CSF1R","CSF3R","CD68","ITGAX")
)


p = DotPlot(sce.all.filt, features = gene_list,
            group.by = "RNA_snn_res.1",
                assay='RNA'  )+RotatedAxis()

MARKER_LIST2_HUMAN <- list(

  T_MARKER = c("PTPRC","CD3E","CD3D","TRDC",'CD4','CD8A','SELL','FOXP3'),

  ILC_MARKER = c("IL7R","RORC","GATA3","IL2RG","ID2","TOX","TCF7"),

  MACRO_MONO = c("LYZ","CD68","CD86","CSF1R","AIF1",
                 "C1QA","C1QB","C1QC","CD14","FCGR3A","ITGAM"),

  DC_MARKER = c("ITGAX",
                ## 小鼠 Ly6c2、Ly6d → 人类对应：
                ## LY6C2 在人类中没有严格同源基因，最接近是 LY6C  
                "LY6C",
                "LY6D"),

  Neutrophil_MARKER = c("S100A8","S100A9"),

  MAST_MARKER = c("CPA3","CST3","KIT"),

  B_MARKER = c("MS4A1","CD19","CD79A"),
  
  PLASMA =c('IGHG1', 'MZB1', 'SDC1'),
  
  proliferation =c('MKI67', 'PCNA')
)

DotPlot(
  object = sce.all.filt,,group.by = "RNA_snn_res.1",features =MARKER_LIST2_HUMAN ,
  assay = "RNA"
) + RotatedAxis()

celltype=data.frame(ClusterID=0:26,
                    celltype= 0:26) 
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(0,12,4,24,5,23,2,25,13,22),2]='T/NK'
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(18),2]='Mast'
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(10,17,19),2]='MYLOID'
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(1,11,15),2]='B'
celltype[celltype$ClusterID %in% c(6,21,7,3,8,14,9,20,26,16),2]='plasma'


sce.all.filt@meta.data$celltype_immune = "NA"
for(i in 1:nrow(celltype)){
  sce.all.filt@meta.data[which(sce.all.filt@meta.data$RNA_snn_res.1 == celltype$ClusterID[i]),'celltype_immune'] <- celltype$celltype[i]}
table(sce.all.filt@meta.data$celltype_immune)
sce.all.filt$disease_rank <- factor(sce.all.filt$disease_rank, levels = c('Healthy', 'Inflammatory (B1)', 'Stricturing (B2)', 'Fistulating (B3)'))
cellRatioPlot(object = sce.all.filt,
              sample.name = "disease",
              celltype.name = "celltype_immune",fill.col = cell_colors)
DimPlot(sce.all.filt,group.by = "celltype_immune",label = T,cols = cell_colors)
getwd()
saveRDS(sce.all.filt,file = 'IMMUNE_MAJOR_IBD.rds')
```

```{r}
####p0###
sce.all.filt$cell_subtype<- sce.all.filt$T_subtype
sce.all.filt$nec_groups<- sce.all.filt$disease
for (tm in unique(sce.all.filt$cell_subtype)) {
  
  # 按细胞类型 subset
  nec_data_subset <- subset(sce.all.filt, subset = cell_subtype == tm)
  if (ncol(nec_data_subset) == 0) next
  
  # 设定分组为 age_disease
  Idents(nec_data_subset) <- "nec_groups"

    dge <- FindMarkers(
    nec_data_subset,
    ident.1 = "UC",
  ident.2 = "HC",
    logfc.threshold = 0.5,   # 你原来是 0.5，这里注意参数名是 logfc.threshold
    test.use = "wilcox",
    min.pct = 0.1,
    min.diff.pct = 0.1,
    only.pos = FALSE,        # 关键：要上下调都要，所以设 FALSE
    max.cells.per.ident = 100,
    assay = "RNA"
  )

  
  dge$celltype  <- tm
  
  # 标记方向（NEC 上调 or Con 上调）
  fc_col <- if ("avg_log2FC" %in% colnames(dge)) "avg_log2FC" else "avg_logFC"
  dge$direction <- ifelse(dge[[fc_col]] > 0, "NEC_p0_up", "Con_p0_up")
  dge <- dge %>% filter(p_val<0.05)
  dge <- dge %>% filter(abs(avg_log2FC)>0.25)
  dge$gene <- rownames(dge)
  DGE_results_p3[[paste0(tm, "_P0_NEc_vs_Con")]] <- dge
}
```
